1.author: Moses
1.purpose: Origins of creation, covenant, and Israel
1.blurb: Genesis opens Scripture with creation, the fall, and God's promise to Abraham.

2.author: Moses
2.purpose: Deliverance from Egypt and covenant at Sinai
2.blurb: Exodus tells how God rescues His people and forms them by His law.

3.author: Moses
3.blurb: Leviticus teaches how a holy God dwells with His people.

4.author: Moses
4.blurb: Numbers records Israel's testing and God's faithfulness in the wilderness.

5.author: Moses
5.purpose: Covenant renewal before entering the land
5.blurb: Deuteronomy calls Israel to love the Lord with all their heart.

6.author: Joshua (trad.)
6.blurb: Joshua shows God keeping His promise to give the land.

7.author: Unknown
7.blurb: Judges warns that everyone did what was right in their own eyes.

8.author: Unknown
8.blurb: Ruth highlights hesed love and God's providence.

9.author: Samuel / others
9.purpose: Rise of monarchy; Saul to David
9.blurb: 1 Samuel traces Israel's request for a king and David's anointing.

10.author: Samuel / others
10.blurb: 2 Samuel shows David's triumphs and failures under God's covenant.

11.author: Unknown
11.blurb: 1 Kings recounts wisdom, idolatry, and prophetic confrontation.

12.author: Unknown
12.blurb: 2 Kings ends with exile—yet hope remains.

13.author: Chronicler
13.blurb: 1 Chronicles encourages worship and covenant identity.

14.author: Chronicler
14.purpose: Judah's kings and temple restoration hope
14.blurb: 2 Chronicles calls the people back to seeking the Lord.

15.author: Ezra
15.blurb: Ezra emphasizes Scripture, repentance, and restoration.

16.author: Nehemiah
16.blurb: Nehemiah models prayerful leadership and reform.

17.author: Unknown
17.blurb: Esther shows God at work even when His name is not named.

18.author: Unknown
18.blurb: Job wrestles with suffering and God's sovereignty.

19.author: David and others
19.blurb: Psalms give voice to every season of the life of faith.

20.author: Solomon and others
20.blurb: Proverbs trains wisdom that fears the Lord.

21.author: Qoheleth (trad. Solomon)
21.blurb: Ecclesiastes pushes us beyond vanity to fear God.

22.author: Solomon (trad.)
22.blurb: Song of Songs celebrates faithful love.

23.author: Isaiah
23.blurb: Isaiah proclaims the Holy One who saves through the Servant.

24.author: Jeremiah
24.blurb: Jeremiah weeps over sin and announces a new covenant.

25.author: Jeremiah
25.blurb: Lamentations mourns judgment while clinging to God's mercies.

26.author: Ezekiel
26.blurb: Ezekiel sees God's presence leave—and return—with hope.

27.author: Daniel
27.blurb: Daniel models courage and reveals God's everlasting kingdom.

28.author: Hosea
28.blurb: Hosea portrays God's relentless love for His people.

29.author: Joel
29.purpose: Day of the Lord and Spirit poured out
29.blurb: Joel calls for repentance and promises restoration.

30.author: Amos
30.blurb: Amos confronts empty religion and social injustice.

31.author: Obadiah
31.blurb: Obadiah warns that pride will be brought low.

32.author: Jonah
32.blurb: Jonah reveals God's compassion beyond Israel's borders.

33.author: Micah
33.blurb: Micah asks what the Lord requires: justice, kindness, humility.

34.author: Nahum
34.blurb: Nahum announces judgment on a violent empire.

35.author: Habakkuk
35.blurb: Habakkuk learns to live by faith amid injustice.

36.author: Zephaniah
36.purpose: Day of the Lord and remnant joy
36.blurb: Zephaniah warns of judgment and sings of God's rejoicing love.

37.author: Haggai
37.blurb: Haggai urges putting God's house first.

38.author: Zechariah
38.blurb: Zechariah points to the coming Branch and humble King.

39.author: Malachi
39.blurb: Malachi confronts half-hearted worship and promises Elijah.

40.author: Matthew
40.blurb: Matthew presents Jesus as Son of David who fulfills Scripture.

41.author: Mark
41.purpose: Jesus the Servant Son of God
41.blurb: Mark is a fast-paced gospel of the crucified King.

42.author: Luke
42.purpose: Jesus the Savior for all peoples
42.blurb: Luke highlights mercy, prayer, and the Spirit.

43.author: John
43.purpose: Believe that Jesus is the Christ
43.blurb: John writes so that you may believe and have life.

44.author: Luke
44.purpose: Spirit-empowered witness to the ends of the earth
44.blurb: Acts continues Jesus' work through the Spirit and the church.

45.author: Paul
45.blurb: Romans unfolds the power of God for salvation.

46.author: Paul
46.blurb: 1 Corinthians applies the cross to church life.

48.author: Paul
48.purpose: Freedom in the gospel of grace
48.blurb: Galatians defends justification by faith alone.

49.author: Paul
49.purpose: Unity in Christ and new life
49.blurb: Ephesians celebrates the church as Christ's body.

50.author: Paul
50.blurb: Philippians centers life on knowing Christ.

51.author: Paul
51.blurb: Colossians exalts Christ over every power.

52.author: Paul
52.purpose: Hope and holy waiting for Christ's return

53.author: Paul
53.purpose: Clarify the day of the Lord

54.author: Paul
54.purpose: Guard the gospel; lead the church
54.blurb: 1 Timothy instructs church order and godliness.

56.author: Paul
56.blurb: Titus plants healthy churches on Crete.

58.author: Unknown (trad. Paul/ Apollos)
58.blurb: Hebrews presents Jesus as better High Priest.

59.author: James
59.blurb: James calls for practical wisdom and integrity.

61.author: Peter
61.purpose: Grow in grace; watch for false teachers
61.blurb: 2 Peter urges diligence until the day of God.

62.author: John
62.blurb: 1 John tests true fellowship with God.

64.author: John
64.blurb: 3 John commends partners in the truth.

66.author: John
66.blurb: Revelation unveils the Lamb who conquers.
